The opening “If His Destiny on table, choose:” was removed (His Destiny is now named only in the last option); the USED option “If a character of ability > 4 was just ‘hit’ during battle, opponent loses 1 Force.” was removed, leaving the Force Pile peek as the only USED text; LOST gained “Steal Luke’s Lightsaber into hand (immune to Weapon Of A Sith).” and the Dark Jedi option became “OR If His Destiny on table, cancel game text of a Dark Jedi with Luke for remainder of turn.” The image also sets USED and LOST on separate lines. The card image prints the errata mark “E1” at bottom right.

Target is power +2 for remainder of turn.”<ref name="cj-4a981d6">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/git/commits/4a981d6112b42bd39d5271735c1f20100a889e0b swccg-card-json commit 4a981d6] “Light - Tweak Set 2026” (15 March 2026) changed the card to this wording.</ref> '''What changed:''' The card became a Lost Interrupt (it was a Used or Lost Interrupt) and was rewritten as four choices under “If His Destiny on table, choose:”: “Luke steals Luke’s Lightsaber. (Immune to Weapon Of A Sith.)”, the new “Cancel Dark Strike, Force Field, or You Are Beaten.”, “Cancel the game text of a Dark Jedi with Luke for remainder of turn.” (“the” added) and the new “Target a Jedi. Target is power +2 for remainder of turn.” The USED Force Pile peek was removed. The card image prints the errata mark “E2” at bottom right.
